biological_description: Dedifferentiation / low identity represents loss of mature parent-cell identity with acquisition of plasticity, progenitor-like, alternate-lineage, or stress-associated features reported in disease or injury contexts.
interpretation_caveat: This is a composite state. Do not interpret marker positivity alone as definitive dedifferentiation; require loss of mature identity and contamination checks.
recommended_portal_summary: A literature-supported plasticity/low-identity concept. Use as a composite score rather than a simple positive state call.
required_supporting_evidence: high dedifferentiation/plasticity marker activity; low mature identity activity; retained parent-cell assignment; low off-target and ambient QC scores
do_not_overinterpret_as: a mutually exclusive subtype or definitive lineage transition in a single cell

biological_description: Disallowed-gene reexpression captures loss of normal cell-type-specific repression of genes that are usually kept low in mature cells.
interpretation_caveat: This is a composite marker concept. Interpret with parent identity retention and off-target QC checks.
recommended_portal_summary: A disease-relevant loss-of-repression marker panel. Use with mature-identity and contamination checks.
required_supporting_evidence: high disallowed-gene activity; parent identity retained; low off-target identity QC; low ambient/doublet signal
do_not_overinterpret_as: proof of dedifferentiation without supporting identity-loss evidence

biological_description: Senescence-like signatures capture cell-cycle arrest, stress-response, SASP-like, and survival-marker features that may occur with aging, injury, or disease.
interpretation_caveat: No single scRNA marker panel definitively identifies senescence. Interpret with viability, cell-cycle, disease, and age context.
recommended_portal_summary: A senescence-like process score. Useful for hypothesis generation but requires composite validation.
required_supporting_evidence: senescence-like activity; low cycling; viable-cell QC; disease/age context; absence of dominant cell-death artifact
do_not_overinterpret_as: definitive cellular senescence in an individual cell

biological_description: UPR / ER stress reflects activation of unfolded-protein-response and ER proteostasis machinery in the parent cell type.
interpretation_caveat: This can reflect real disease or physiological stress, but can also be influenced by handling and dissociation.
recommended_portal_summary: A well-established stress-response process, best interpreted as a continuous activity gradient.
required_supporting_evidence: high UPR activity; donor/sample context; QC and batch review when extreme

biological_description: Interferon / MHC response captures inflammatory, antiviral, and antigen-presentation activity within the parent cell type.
interpretation_caveat: This can be real inflammatory biology, but immune contamination, HLA-high ambient RNA, and doublets should be checked.
recommended_portal_summary: A well-established inflammatory process score, best interpreted as a continuous gradient.
required_supporting_evidence: high IFN/MHC activity; parent identity retained; low immune contamination/doublet scores
do_not_overinterpret_as: a distinct immune cell identity unless parent-cell assignment supports it

biological_description: Oxidative / mitochondrial stress captures antioxidant response, mitochondrial proteostasis, and cellular stress-response activity.
interpretation_caveat: Distinguish biological oxidative stress from high mitochondrial-read QC artifacts. Use as a stress score, not a discrete state.
recommended_portal_summary: A QC-sensitive cellular stress activity score. Interpret with mitochondrial fraction and cell-quality metrics.
required_supporting_evidence: high oxidative-stress activity; not explained by percent mitochondrial or low-complexity QC
do_not_overinterpret_as: a definitive mitochondrial disease state or bad-cell label

biological_description: Proliferation / cell cycle captures cycling cells using canonical S/G2M and mitotic markers.
interpretation_caveat: The marker panel is generic across cell types. Hard calls are only appropriate if the score distribution supports a separable cycling population.
recommended_portal_summary: A well-established cell-cycle process. Can be hard-callable when score distributions separate.
required_supporting_evidence: high cell-cycle activity; adequate marker coverage; separable score distribution; parent identity retained
do_not_overinterpret_as: a new subtype or a disease-specific program by itself
quality_badges: Well-established cell-cycle process;Potentially hard-callable if separable
